stem: The bar graph shows the number of solar panels a company installed in each quarter of one year. The number of panels installed in the fourth quarter is what percent of the number installed in the first quarter?
solution: From the graph, 50 panels were installed in the first quarter and 70 in the fourth quarter.

explanation.A: Incorrect. This is the percent increase from the first quarter to the fourth quarter, \(\frac{20}{50} = 40\%\), not the fourth-quarter number as a percent of the first.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is the first-quarter number as a percent of the fourth-quarter number, \(\frac{50}{70} \approx 71.4\%\).
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is the difference, 20 panels, written as a percent.

verify:
choices = {o: choices[n] for o, n in {'B': 'A', 'D': 'B', 'C': 'C', 'A': 'D'}.items()}; answer = {'A': 'B', 'B': 'D', 'C': 'C', 'D': 'A'}[answer]  # shuffled: original letters
pts = dict(figure['series'][0]['points'])
ans = Rational(pts['Q4'], pts['Q1'])
assert ans == Rational(7, 5)
assert value(choices[answer]) == ans
assert all(value(choices[k]) != ans for k in choices if k != answer)
assert abs(value(choices['C']) - Rational(pts['Q1'], pts['Q4'])) < Rational(1, 1000)
